title: Dong et al. (2013): QD reference and supernatants from nitrate/DBS parent mixtures
scopeLabel: Main and local supporting-information material preparations, size/loading contexts and selected structural/optical evidence. Analytical chemiluminescence reactions, calibration, oxidation challenges, snow-sample analysis, selectivity and mechanisms are outside this preparation scope; no complete-paper Reader. Parent-mixture labels identify the starting comparison systems; separated-supernatant composition and residual concentrations are unreported.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
